description: Agent Logistics: submit one shipment’s proof of delivery with its delivery terms: the terms with whether they require delivery confirmation, the signature they require (none, any signature, the named recipient’s or an adult’s), the recipient they name, the places the shipment may be left, the destination postal code, whether a photo or a note is required, the last day allowed for delivery and their text; and the proof of delivery with its status (delivered, attempted or none), when delivery was recorded with its time and offset, who signed, the signature on the record, whether an adult was verified, where the shipment was left, the delivery postal code, whether a photo is on the record, the delivery note and its reference. The signed report gives the terms, the record, whether a delivery confirmation is present, the signature required against the signature recorded with whether the signer is the named recipient and whether an adult was verified, the place left against the places allowed and the delivery postal code against the terms’, the delivery day against the last day allowed, and the photo and note evidence, and counts them, and names an unproven delivery: no delivery confirmation, a signature missing where the terms require one, a signature from someone other than the named recipient, no adult verification where the terms require it, a place the terms do not allow and another delivery postal code; then a photo or a note the terms require that the record lacks and a delivery after the last day allowed, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No signature requirement in the terms, no recipient for a recipient signature, no place on the record where the terms list places, or no delivery time leaves the proof unverified. This reads one shipment’s own proof-of-delivery record against its terms: a vendor’s stated proof of delivery before the spend is wever_vendor-delivery-check, how a receiving agent confirms it took a task is wever_handoff-acceptance-check and delivered work against its acceptance criteria is wever_deliverable-check. Verdict logistics_pod_unproven, logistics_pod_partial, logistics_pod_unverified or logistics_pod_proven. POST /api/logistics-pod-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

adult_verified.description: Whether an adult was verified, as recorded.

delivered_at.description: When delivery was recorded, with its time and offset where recorded, such as 2026-12-02.

location.description: Where the shipment was left, as recorded.

photo.description: Whether a delivery photo is on the record.

status.description: Whether the record shows a delivery, only an attempt, or nothing.

confirmation_required.description: Whether the terms require delivery confirmation.

deliver_by.description: The last day the terms allow for delivery, such as 2026-12-02.

locations.description: The places the terms allow the shipment to be left, such as reception or a locker.

note_required.description: Whether the terms require a delivery note.

photo_required.description: Whether the terms require a delivery photo.

signature.description: The signature the terms require: none, any signature, the named recipient’s or an adult’s.

name: wever_logistics-pod-check
title: Logistics proof of delivery check
